name: Reclaimed Treasures
label: Quest
description: Reclaimed Treasures: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Sweeping the bat pens with this broom is not befitting a Garrett! I've earned a little coin from this accursed job, and I'm willing to spend it on you to better my station.

The Garrett family weapon of choice is locked away in our chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman from when we Garretts toiled there as diggers. Without it, I will be stuck here forever - literally - sweeping up after these infernal bats.
Reclaim my family's treasure and bring it to me! Help me restore my birthright!

clips.title: Progress
paras: The sweeping never ends... These bats are prolific in their mockery of me and my broom. Please tell me you've reclaimed my family's treasure! I've offered you my silver - is that not enough?!

clips.title: Completion
paras: At last - a broom worthy of a Garrett. You're bloody well worth every silver I spent on you, I say!
Do you hear me, foul bats? I now wield the Garrett family weapon of choice! Tremble, bats, tremble!!
